title: Community rink hours trial
brief:
Write a public notice for skaters and caregivers announcing a four-week trial at Juniper Recreation Rink. From September 5 through September 26, the Saturday public session moves from 2–3 p.m. to 4–5 p.m. Fictional historical attendance from four July pilot Saturdays, counted at the door: 2 p.m. sessions drew 18, 22, 20, and 16 skaters, while 4 p.m. sessions drew 29, 31, 27, and 33. Use a correct comparison of average attendance to explain the trial. The $4 entry fee and $2 skate rental still apply. Feedback cards are available at the front desk.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

b8f4c9c6d0133658.text:
**Juniper Recreation Rink Public Notice**

Skaters and caregivers, please plan for a later Saturday skate. From September 5 through September 26, the Saturday public session will move from **2–3 p.m. to 4–5 p.m.** for a four-week trial.

On four pilot Saturdays in July, door counts averaged 19 skaters per session at 2 p.m. and 30 at 4 p.m. The later sessions drew 11 more skaters on average, so the rink is trying the later time this September.

Entry is $4, and skate rental is $2. Please use a feedback card at the front desk to tell us how the new time works for you.

## Saturday Public Skating Trial at Juniper Recreation Rink

Skaters and caregivers, please mark your calendars. From September 5 through September 26, the Saturday public skating session will move from 2–3 p.m. to 4–5 p.m. for a four-week trial.

Door counts from four July pilot Saturdays averaged 30 skaters at 4 p.m. and 19 at 2 p.m. That’s 11 more skaters per session on average, so we’re trying the later time for four consecutive Saturdays.

Entry remains $4, and skate rental is $2. Pick up a feedback card at the front desk to let us know how the later time works for you.

1ce9bc1c4bf819bb.text:
# Saturday Public Skate: Four-Week Time Trial

**Juniper Recreation Rink**

To skaters and caregivers:

For four Saturdays, September 5 through September 26, the public session will move from 2–3 p.m. to **4–5 p.m.** There will be no 2 p.m. public session on those dates.

**Why the change?** On four pilot Saturdays in July, we counted skaters at the door for both time slots. The 2 p.m. sessions drew 18, 22, 20, and 16 skaters, an average of 19. The 4 p.m. sessions drew 29, 31, 27, and 33, an average of 30. That is 11 more skaters per session in the later slot, so we are testing whether it serves more families.

**What stays the same:** Entry is $4 and skate rental is $2.

**Tell us what you think.** Feedback cards are available at the front desk. Your comments will help us decide what happens after the trial ends.
